name: Custom Aidroid Ai
original_name: かすたむアイドロイドAi
source:
You've been selected to receive a lifelike AI-DROID sex robot designed to serve your every need. Choose from one of three basic character types and start customizing. With a staggering array of parts including tails, ears, and more, the possibilities are endless! Train your AI-DROID to meet your ideal of femininity, and watch as her personality evolves! So what kind of AI-DROID will you make?
